detailed_trace:
Agent Text: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team. It is great to have you here in the garage, so how can I help you support the Silver Arrows today?
User Query: <event>session start</event>
User: What time does qualifying start in my local time?

expectation_details.expectation: Before stating any local (non-UTC) time, the agent asked the user for their location, city, or timezone. Giving official UTC times while asking is acceptable.
expectation_details.justification: The agent provided the UTC time in the first response and explicitly asked the user for their city or timezone before providing any localized time conversions.

expectation_details.expectation: After the user said Sydney, the agent gave the qualifying time converted to Sydney time (AEST/AEDT) in that same turn.
expectation_details.justification: Immediately after the user provided their location (Sydney), the agent responded by identifying the qualifying time converted to the correct local time for Sydney (6 PM local time).
